description.text: A special expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 22 September 2023 and built on the 151 Pokémon first found in Kanto: every one of them has a card, in Pokédex order. It has 207 cards, 165 in the main numbering and 42 secret rares, with 12 new Pokémon ex led by Venusaur ex, Charizard ex, Blastoise ex and Mew ex. Some of its illustrations follow a whole evolution line, each line drawn by a single artist.
